description: Move monetary math off PHP floats to integer minor units (cents) (F-6). Pricing/BOM currently add decimal:2 cast STRINGS as floats, risking rounding drift in a quoting system. Introduce a dependency-free money helper and rewrite PricingService and BomGeneratorService money math in cents, formatting only at the edges; stop binding ProductBuilder base_price as a raw float. Must land before FEAT-003 so the rule engine's set_price override is computed in cents. Depends on FEAT-001 (BomGeneratorService is now the single BOM service).
steps: Create app/Support/Money.php (plain class, 'php artisan make:class' or hand-written) with typed static helpers, no new dependency: toCents(string|int|float|null $amount): int (round half-up at 2dp), fromCents(int $cents): string (returns a 2dp decimal string), addCents(int ...$cents): int, mulCents(int $cents, string|int|float $qty): int (quantity may be fractional decimal(8,2); multiply then round half-up). Add PHPDoc.

Rewrite PricingService::calculate() to accumulate base_price and each option price_adjustment in integer cents (options_total, subtotal, total). Keep the returned array shape/keys stable (base_price, option_adjustments[].adjustment, options_total, subtotal, discount, total, currency) but return normalized 2dp decimal strings via Money::fromCents at the edge. discount stays 0.

Rewrite the money math in BomGeneratorService::generate() to compute unit_price, cost, and total_price (quantity * unit_price) in cents and emit normalized values at the edge; keep every existing row key and the overall rich shape unchanged. quantity remains a decimal(8,2) value.

Change app/Livewire/Admin/ProductBuilder.php $base_price from 'public float' to 'public string' (default '0'); update fillFromProduct() to cast the model value to string and save() to pass the string. Keep validation 'base_price' => 'required|numeric|min:0'. Verify the ProductBuilderGuardTest (Phase 1) still passes.

Add tests/Feature/MoneyHandlingTest.php (Pest): two option adjustments 0.10 + 0.20 sum to exactly '0.30' (string compare, no 0.1+0.2 drift); product base plus several adjustments equals the exact decimal; a BOM row total_price equals quantity*unit_price exactly. Run Pint and targeted tests, then re-run BomParity to confirm the shape is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: No pricing/BOM monetary accumulation uses float addition; sums are exact (MoneyHandlingTest passes, including 0.10+0.20=0.30).
PricingService::calculate() and BomGeneratorService::generate() keep their existing public array/row shapes.
ProductBuilder::$base_price is no longer a float-typed public property; ProductBuilderGuardTest still passes.
No new Composer dependency was added.
findings:
DONE. Full suite green: 28 passed (25 prior + MoneyHandlingTest 3). Targeted MoneyHandling+BomParity green. No Composer dependency added; integer cents only.

=== app/Support/Money.php (plain static class) ===
Method signatures:
- public static function toCents(string|int|float|null $amount): int  // null/'' => 0; round(($amount*100), 0, PHP_ROUND_HALF_UP)
- public static function fromCents(int $cents): string  // number_format($cents/100, 2, '.', '') -> 2dp string, no thousands sep
- public static function addCents(int ...$cents): int  // array_sum
- public static function mulCents(int $cents, string|int|float $qty): int  // round($cents*$qty, 0, PHP_ROUND_HALF_UP)
All money math accumulates in integer cents and formats to a normalized 2dp decimal string ONLY at the edge via fromCents.

=== PricingService::calculate() shape (UNCHANGED keys) ===
Returns array<string,mixed>: base_price (2dp string), option_adjustments (array of {option_name:string, adjustment:2dp string}), options_total (2dp string), subtotal (2dp string), discount (int 0), total (2dp string), currency (string). Internally: baseCents=toCents(basePrice); each adjustment toCents, pushed only when !=0 cents; optionsCents via addCents; subtotalCents=addCents(baseCents, optionsCents). discount stays 0 (int). Verified 0.10+0.20 => '0.30' exactly; 100.05+0.10+0.20 => subtotal/total '100.35'. Consumers unaffected: ProductConfigurator writes pricing['total'] to decimal:2 total_price column (string ok); DTO ConfigurationResult->pricing carries the array.

=== BomGeneratorService::generate() row shape (UNCHANGED keys) ===
Each row keys: item_no (zero-padded string), component_id (int), part_number, sales_part_number, description, long_description, type, manufacturer, manufacturer_part_no, quantity (float), unit ('EA'), unit_price (2dp string via fromCents), cost (2dp string via fromCents), total_price (2dp string via fromCents), currency, is_mandatory (bool), lead_time (null), remarks (null). Money fields CHANGED TYPE float->2dp decimal string (quantity stays float). unitPriceCents=toCents(sales_price); totalPriceCents=mulCents(unitPriceCents, quantity). On duplicate component_id accumulation: quantity sums as float, total_price recomputed = fromCents(mulCents(toCents(stored unit_price string), new quantity)). Verified qty 3 * 12.34 => total_price '37.02'. BomParity still green (both save & generate paths run the same generate(), identical rows). validate() numeric-string comparisons ($item['unit_price'] <= 0, quantity <= 0) still valid on the 2dp strings.

=== ProductBuilder ===
$base_price changed from 'public float $base_price = 0' to 'public string $base_price = '0''. fillFromProduct casts model value with (string). save() passes the string to the decimal:2 base_price column. Validation 'base_price'=>'required|numeric|min:0' unchanged. ProductBuilderGuardTest still passes.

=== Tests ===
tests/Feature/MoneyHandlingTest.php (Pest, no seeder needed): (1) two adjustments 0.10+0.20 == '0.30' via PricingService with no PriceList (falls back to product/option raw columns); (2) base 100.05 + 0.10 + 0.20 subtotal/total '100.35'; (3) BOM row via BomRule (no conditions => passes) + BomRuleItem qty 3, component sales_price 12.34, asserts unit_price '12.34' and total_price '37.02'. String compares throughout to catch float drift.
